raw_site_text: the provinces of Singida, Iramba, Kongwa, Kiteto, Morogoro and Mvomero were identified as suitable for the project
justification: Districts Singida/Iramba (Singida region), Kongwa (Dodoma), Kiteto (Manyara), Morogoro/Mvomero (Morogoro) rolled up from geographic knowledge.
note: Paper also studies Mozambique (Manica/Sofala districts), not in paper_countries.
